title: Advancing Entropy-Level Credit Assignment in RLVR via Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.39402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Value-model-free RLVR methods such as GRPO assign uniform advantages to all tokens in a rollout, ignoring that tokens contribute unequally. Recent methods use token entropy as an importance proxy but compute it globally across the batch, conflating importance with prompt difficulty and positional trends. We argue that importance should instead be measured relative to the local context of each token. We introduce proximal entropy, a local measure of token importance relative to neighboring tokens, and prove it is invariant to both confounders. Proximal Entropy Policy Optimization (PEPO) uses it to weight per-token advantages and outperforms GRPO and entropy-based baselines on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3-1.7B, Qwen3-4B, and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. translated_title: 基于近端熵策略优化推进RLVR中的熵级信用分配
translated_abstract: 诸如GRPO等无价值模型的RLVR方法在一条rollout中为所有token分配统一的优势，忽略了各token贡献并不均等的事实。近期方法将token熵用作重要性的代理指标，但其在整个批次上全局计算，将重要性与提示难度和位置趋势混为一谈。我们认为，重要性应当相对于每个token的局部上下文来衡量。我们提出了近端熵，这是一种衡量token相对于其相邻token重要性的局部度量，并证明它对上述两种混淆因素均具有不变性。近端熵策略优化利用近端熵对逐token的优势进行加权，在Qwen3-1.7B、Qwen3-4B和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct上的数学推理任务中优于GRPO及基于熵的基线方法。我们还表明该框架可推广到其他算法：将近端熵代入现有方法即可带来提升，而将其应用于单流RL时，在全局熵失效的情形下也能取得成功。
tldr: 提出近端熵这一相对于局部上下文的token重要性度量（对提示难度和位置趋势不变），并用其构建PEPO算法对逐token优势加权，在多个模型规模和架构的数学推理任务上超越GRPO及基于熵的基线方法。
en_tdlr: Proposes proximal entropy, a local token importance measure invariant to prompt difficulty and positional trends, and uses it in PEPO to weight per-token advantages, outperforming GRPO and entropy-based baselines on mathematical reasoning across multiple models.
